message:
As a self-proclaimed champion of preparedness, I find a great deal of comfort in having a plan. It’s not just about being ready for the unexpected; it’s about knowing I’ve taken the time to think things through. The resources available at Ready.gov help guide us in making thoughtful choices for our families, ensuring we're all on the same page when life throws us a curveball. 

I like to think of it as my little way of caring for my loved ones, even when the sun is shining. How do you prepare for the unknown?
